about.title: About Bahrain Lawyers Platform
about.description: Lawyers.bh is an electronic mediation platform established to provide a range of legal services and consultations through licensed lawyers and legal advisors authorized by the Ministry of Justice, Islamic Affairs and Endowments, as well as licensed institutions and companies registered with the Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Tourism — all officially listed on the platform to ensure maximum benefit for clients, facilitate access to legal rights, promote transparency in litigation, and connect beneficiaries with judicial and legal service providers easily and efficiently.
about.legalNoticeText: All lawyers and legal offices displayed on this platform are officially registered in the Roll of Lawyers with the Ministry of Justice, Islamic Affairs and Waqf, duly licensed in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations of the Kingdom of Bahrain.
